title: Prime Minister congratulates Naveen Sivakumar on winning Gold at the Asian Para Games
body_text: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today congratulated Naveen Sivakumar for a memorable debut, winning Gold in Men’s Singles SL4 at the Asian Para Games. Shri Modi stated that his outstanding performance has brought glory to the nation, expressing hope that he continues to achieve new milestones and inspire fellow athletes. In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared: "A memorable debut for Naveen Sivakumar at the Asian Para Games! Congratulations on winning Gold in Men’s Singles SL4. His outstanding performance has brought glory to the nation. May he continue to achieve new milestones and inspire fellow athletes: PM @narendramodi" A memorable debut for Naveen Sivakumar at the Asian Para Games! Congratulations on winning Gold in Men’s Singles SL4. His outstanding performance has brought glory to the nation.
